notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR23: the input-output CD information "constitutes the communication between the MCS and the program about the message being handled" and "does not come from the terminal as part of the message". MessageControlSession.Receive/Transfer put only the message text into the INTO item and the date, time, length, end key and status into the CD area (CommunicationArea.SetReceived), and SendToTerminal transmits only the text. Probes at 85: RECEIVE SEGMENT and MESSAGE from a terminal filled [AB**] then [CDEF] with lengths 2 and 4, end keys 1 and 2; SEND wrote only REPLY123 to the device; changing the terminal name after the first statement gave 20; the witness checks the RECEIVE.

next.reason: 1985: "The input-output CD information constitutes the communication between the MCS and the program about the message being handled."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the communication description entry; the Communication module (CD, MCS) is absent.". No 2023 clause holds the CD feature. The wording candidates cover only data, file, sort-merge, report and screen entries. The communication module is dropped in 2023.
